summary: Mr. Arking discusses the different opinions and customs regarding when the father of the baby recites the blessing at a Brit Milah. He examines the views of authorities such as Rashbam, Rabbeinu Tam, and Maran in the Shulchan Aruch, as well as the customs in Aleppo, Damascus, Iraq, Jerusalem, Egypt, and North African communities.
questions: When should the father recite the blessing at a Brit Milah?
What is the difference between the opinions of Rashbam and Rabbeinu Tam regarding the blessing?
How does the Shulchan Aruch rule on the timing of the blessing?
What was the custom in Aleppo, Syria, and other communities regarding the blessing?
What is the correct wording in the final blessing of the Brit Milah according to Machshirei Milah?
